vc_checking.summary: All seven cleaned manual obligations are semantically proofable under the current annotation and seed case_lib. The entry obligation opens the circular DLL and partitions the anchor into member/sentinel and empty/nonempty-suffix cases, exactly matching the four return configurations. Each return obligation can select its full-DLL disjunct and fold the updated field ownership into the dispatch result already supplied as a pure precondition. The two contract-derivation obligations choose the original head/list; their wands are identity frames after dispatch reduction, with the member case using the semantic fact that a represented DLL member cannot be its sentinel. No annotation/spec repair is required.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: If PreH1 is membership, apply xizi_in_first_split_after__implementation_shape to obtain nodes_before/nodes_after, split the dllseg at linklist_pre, then destruct nodes_after. If PreH1 is sentinel equality, substitute linklist_pre=head_dispatch_case and destruct nodes_dispatch_case. In all cases use the link values exposed by unfolding as the generated existentials.
witnesses.space_plan: Apply xizi_dll_open; in the member branch use a suffixed dllseg-split helper to isolate anchor links and the suffix segment, while in the sentinel branch unfold the complete segment at nil/cons. Cancel the unchanged stack and standalone-node resources into the selected assertion branch.
witnesses.pure_plan: Membership first yields prefix/suffix and ~In anchor prefix. The seed xizi_insert_after_first_occurrence__implementation_shape discharges the member dispatch list equation; sentinel equality reduces xizi_double_link_insert_after_dispatch_nodes by Z.eq_dec. Non-null and address-distinct guards come from xizi_dll_node, dllseg conjuncts, and separated complete link records, not arithmetic automation.
witnesses.refinement_plan: Not applicable; this is a direct spatial/list representation proof with no safeExec state.
premise_discharge: The first-occurrence lemma premise In linklist_pre nodes_dispatch_case is exactly the left branch of PreH1.
The split helper's list-shape premise is obtained by rewriting the first-occurrence decomposition.
The member-not-head fact follows by opening xizi_dll and inducting over dllseg, whose nonempty branch explicitly requires node<>stop.
All existential field values are read from owned points-to resources after unfolding; no missing ownership is synthesized.
witnesses.failure_signal: None. Every one of the four post branches corresponds to a complete semantic case of PreH1 plus empty/nonempty abstract suffix.
